SkyWater Technology has committed to developing science-based greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets and submitting them for validation by the[Science Based Targets initiative](https://sciencebasedtargets.org/) (SBTi).


The Science Based Targets initiative sets criteria companies can use to determine how much and how quickly to cut greenhouse gas emissions in line with climate science. SBTi grew out of a collaboration involving CDP, the United Nations Global Compact, the We Mean Business Coalition, World Resources Institute and the World Wide Fund for Nature. Its subsidiary, SBTi Services, reviews submitted targets against those criteria.


Through this commitment, SkyWater will develop targets for assessment against SBTi’s criteria.


For companies, science-based targets provide a structured approach to managing emissions, prioritizing reduction efforts and measuring progress. Independent validation helps build confidence in the ambition of those targets, while a shared framework supports collaboration with customers and suppliers pursuing their own sustainability goals.


This step supports SkyWater’s ongoing efforts to understand and address its environmental impact while supporting stakeholders’ sustainability priorities.


As a U.S.-based semiconductor manufacturer, SkyWater helps strengthen the domestic supply chain for technologies serving critical industries. Our development and manufacturing capabilities support applications in quantum computing, advanced sensing, thermal imaging, and aerospace and defense, helping customers bring specialized semiconductor innovations from concept to production.
